items.title: A cocone of schemes is a colimit if it is fpqc locally a colimit on overlaps
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a diagram of schemes over S with cocone W, if some fpqc covering {W_a -> W} trivializes the colimit property both for each W_a and for each overlap W_a x_W W_b (as colimits of the base-changed diagram), then W itself is the colimit of the diagram in the category of schemes. The retained proof writes out the decisive reduction: a morphism W -> T out of the cocone is the same thing as a collection of morphisms W_a -> T agreeing on the overlaps W_a x_W W_b, which is exactly the fpqc universal effective epimorphism property of the covering (Descent), so the compatible families indexed by the diagram glue uniquely through W. Retained author proof at lines 4199-4204.
